resources.string: Choose an app window in the Android prompt when available. On older devices the whole display may be captured. Avoid password fields and disappearing content. Captures are encrypted temporarily; return to Sakshi, unlock and review each frame before saving. Screen lock, expiry or process death removes unreviewed frames.
Enable Sakshi notifications to keep Android’s visible Stop control available during capture.

Capture starts in five seconds. Switch to the screen you want and scroll yourself.

Copies the screen pixels Android allows
Frames stay encrypted until you save or discard them

Reads visible text of chat apps you pick, up to five minutes
Text stays in memory until you review it
Stop or disable any time to clear drafts

Accessibility access can expose text from other apps. Sakshi reads only visible text from the chat apps you select, for up to five minutes, and automates no tapping, scrolling, replying or screenshots. Do not open View Once or disappearing-content screens. Drafts stay in memory until review; screen lock, revocation or process exit clears them. Sensitive screens stop capture, but detection is incomplete. Inaccessible content is never recovered. It cannot capture every message or confirm who sent one.
